description: This file contains functions and type definitions for interacting with Slack directory data, including listing users and channels, filtering, and ranking them.

methods.name: resolveReadToken
methods.description: Resolves the Slack token (user or bot) from configuration parameters.

methods.name: normalizeQuery
methods.description: Normalizes a query string by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: buildUserRank
methods.description: Calculates a rank for a Slack user based on deletion status and bot/app user status.

methods.name: buildChannelRank
methods.description: Calculates a rank for a Slack channel based on whether it is archived.

methods.name: listSlackDirectoryPeersLive
methods.description: Lists Slack users matching a query, with optional limit, returning directory entries.

methods.name: listSlackDirectoryGroupsLive
methods.description: Lists Slack channels matching a query, with optional limit, returning directory entries.
